name: CharLove
source:
Charlotte from Inf*nite Stratos sneaks into Ichika's room while he sleeps... and can't help herself. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081989.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
《无尽斯特拉托斯》中的夏洛特趁一花熟睡时潜入他的房间……并且无法自拔。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE081989.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
